_help: Verb Hunt stories (levels). Every game gives the player one story at random (config.json > english > randomStory). Keep each story at 35 verbs or fewer. To add a story, copy the whole { ... } block of Level 1, paste it after it (put a comma between the blocks), and change the text. 'answers' has ONE list per sentence, in order: list the verbs of sentence 1, then sentence 2, and so on (use [] for a sentence with no verbs). Write each verb exactly as it appears in the paragraph, without punctuation. If the same word appears twice in one sentence, list it twice to mark both; to mark only the 2nd one, write it as "word#2". Sentences are split at . ! and ? - if your paragraph contains abbreviations like 'Mr.' or 'e.g.', replace "paragraph" with "sentences": ["First sentence.", "Second sentence."]. Add ? after a word ("dressed?") for an arguable word that may be tapped or skipped without penalty. The verb total (e.g. 37) is counted automatically.
title: Verb Hunt!
tagline: Find every verb hiding in the story.

levels.title: The Unexpected Day
levels.paragraph: Sara was walking home when she noticed something unusual. A small crowd had gathered near the park entrance. Curious, she moved closer to see what was happening. A street performer was entertaining the crowd with a strange-looking machine. He explained how the machine worked and invited someone to try it. A little boy stepped forward and pressed a button. Suddenly, the machine began making a loud noise. Everyone looked surprised, but the performer remained calm. He quickly switched it off and examined the controls. The crowd started laughing when they realized that nothing dangerous had happened. Sara took out her phone and recorded the funny moment. Later that evening, Sara showed the video to her family. Before going to bed, she watched the recording again and noticed something funny in the background.

levels.title: The Lost Kite
levels.paragraph: Rafi woke up early on Friday morning. The sky was clear, and a cool wind was blowing. He grabbed his red kite and ran to the field behind his house. His little sister followed him with a ball of string. Together they tied the string carefully and lifted the kite into the air. Within minutes, it was flying high above the trees. Suddenly, a strong gust pulled the string out of Rafi's hands. The kite drifted away and landed on the roof of an old school. Rafi felt sad, but his sister had an idea. They walked to the school and asked the guard for help. The kind guard found a long ladder and climbed onto the roof. He carefully brought the kite down and handed it to Rafi. Rafi thanked him and promised that he would hold the string tightly next time. On the way home, the children laughed and talked about their adventure. That night, Rafi dreamed that his kite was flying all the way to the moon.

levels.title: The Science Fair
levels.paragraph: Nadia had worked on her science project for three weeks. She built a small windmill that could power a tiny light. On the morning of the fair, she packed everything into a box and carried it to school. The hall was full of students, teachers and parents. Nadia set up her table and checked every wire twice. When the judges arrived, her hands started shaking. She took a deep breath and explained how the windmill turned wind into electricity. Then she switched on the fan. The blades spun quickly, but the light did not glow. Nadia stayed calm and looked at the wires again. She noticed that one wire had come loose. She fixed it quickly, and the little bulb began to shine. The judges smiled and wrote something in their notebooks. At the end of the day, Nadia won second prize. She hugged her teacher and thanked her for the help.

levels.title: A Rainy Afternoon
levels.paragraph: It was raining heavily when school ended. Tanvir had forgotten his umbrella at home. He waited under the roof and watched the water flood the road. An old man with a large umbrella stopped beside him. He smiled and offered to share it. They walked slowly together and talked about books. The man told Tanvir that he had taught English at the same school many years ago. When they reached the bus stop, the rain stopped. Tanvir thanked the man and asked for his name. The man only laughed and waved goodbye. At home, Tanvir told his mother about the kind stranger. She looked at an old photo and smiled. The man in the picture was her own favourite teacher. The next day, Tanvir bought a new umbrella and kept it in his bag. He wanted to help someone else on a rainy day.

levels.title: The Missing Cake
levels.paragraph: Mother baked a chocolate cake for Rina's birthday. She placed it on the kitchen table and went to the market. When she came back, half of the cake had disappeared. Rina and her brother Sami looked at each other. Both of them said that they had not touched it. Mother searched the kitchen for clues. She found small chocolate footprints on the floor. They followed the tiny marks to the back door. Outside, their puppy was sleeping under a tree. His nose and paws were brown with chocolate. Everyone started laughing at the sleepy thief. Sami picked up the puppy and carried him inside. Mother explained that chocolate can make dogs very sick. They called the doctor, who checked the puppy carefully. Luckily, he had eaten only a little, so he was fine. That evening, the family cut the rest of the cake and sang happy birthday to Rina. The puppy watched them from his bed with sad eyes.
